title: Deep Binding of Language Model Virtual Personas: a Study on Approximating Political Partisan Misperceptions
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the ability of LLMs to replicate human perceptions of morality as a core component of its study. Specifically, it uses the ATP Wave 110 survey to evaluate trait dimensions including 'morality' and provides detailed response distributions for 'perceived moral standing' of political groups. Additionally, it investigates the 'subversion gap' which relates to political ethics and the perceived willingness of groups to violate ethical democratic boundaries.
